# mevspace_templates (Data Source)

Available OS templates. Does not require an API token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mevspace_templates" "dedicated" {
  type = "dedicated"
}

output "template_names" {
  value = [for t in data.mevspace_templates.dedicated.items : "${t.id}: ${t.name}"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `type` (String) Filter: dedicated, vps or vps_cloud.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
